scope: Exact finite certificates through conformal weight six plus listed weight-seven sectors; no all-weight presentation or worldwide priority claim.

equations.title: lattice realization of the level-one vacuum map
equations.assumptions: Frenkel-Kac lattice VOA of the E8 root lattice with the package bimultiplicative cocycle; all61504ordered basis pairs and modes0..3 are checked through the actual vertex operators.

equations.title: lattice null criterion
equations.equation: v in N <=> phi(v)=0, N the maximal proper submodule of V^1(E8)
equations.assumptions: phi is a vacuum-module map onto the simple V_L, which is generated by its weight-one space; Borcherds commutator formula gives the affine relations from the checked brackets and forms.

equations.title: weight-four lift replay
equations.assumptions: Independent lattice confirmation of the retained804-term null lift; 44=dim L4 at weight lambda=p8(2).

equations.title: ideal highest vectors at length three
equations.equation: HW_mu(ideal_n,len3)=span{z[n-3-k]D^k(i): z tensor i in HW_mu(g tensor I),0<=k<=n-3}
equations.assumptions: I=ker(Omega-2) in Sym^2 g; equivariance and complete reducibility make nonmembership a highest-vector rank test.

equations.title: weight-five 147250 primitive
equations.assumptions: H002,H011 are the primitive integral omega8 highest vectors of shapes (0,0,2),(0,1,1). No length<=2 state has weight omega8; g tensor I has no omega8 highest vector.

equations.title: weight-five 248 primitive
equations.assumptions: u=e_theta; x,y,z are universal divided jets of orders0,1,2. The class is nonzero modulo the ideal: highest-vector rank3->4 and full weight-space modular rank against the proved character.

equations.title: weight-five 248 null lift
equations.assumptions: Symmetrized PBW lift with x^[r] <-> x[-r-1]; its lattice image vanishes exactly.

equations.title: weight-five kernel by highest weight
equations.assumptions: Direct sector computations; kernel multiplicities1,1,1 and the 779247 control0.

equations.title: weight-six 30380 primitive
equations.assumptions: v=e_(theta-alpha6); A_rst=sum_a([u,t_a]^(r)v^(s)-(u<->v))(t^a)^(t), B_rst=sum_(a,b)[[u,t_a],[v,t_b]]^(r)(t^a)^(s)(t^b)^(t)-(u<->v). No combination of at most five of the14 tensors suffices.

equations.title: length-four 3875 is a product
equations.assumptions: T_-lambda spans the one-dimensional weight -lambda part of Sym^2W cap ker mu, the retained dual of A6 length4; Schur lemma reduces the product map to the action.

equations.title: quartic invariant is decomposable
equations.equation: F0 = (91/155)*sum_a x_(t^a)[0]P_248^(t_a) modulo the arc ideal; 91/155=947856/(248*kappa), kappa=6510
equations.assumptions: kappa=T0(x_(-theta)[0]P_248) is nonzero; T0 annihilates the full length-four ideal (123256 checks). Hence F0 lies in K6 and its gr image is zero.

equations.title: weight-six Li-bigraded kernel
equations.assumptions: Short-current injectivity, product functionals on length four, the exact total K6 character and direct length-three sectors.

equations.title: minimal differential generators through weight six
equations.assumptions: For the commutative differential ideal K of the arc algebra; all other weight<=6 classes are derivatives or products. No all-weight presentation or finite generation is asserted.

equations.title: weight-seven length-three partial table
equations.assumptions: Only the listed highest weights; the 248 and singlet length-three sectors and the length-four Li-degree-three sector are not classified.
